definitions.explanation: The continent of North America, including Canada, the United States, and Mexico. In Japanese geographical classification, sometimes also includes Central America and the Caribbean.

examples.japanese: {北|きた}アメリカは{広|ひろ}い。
{北|きた}アメリカ{大陸|たいりく}には{多|おお}くの{国|くに}がある。
examples.english: There are many countries on the North American continent.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{北|きた}アメリカを{一周|いっしゅう}する{旅|たび}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: He set out on a trip around North America.

notes:
Written either as {北|きた}アメリカ or {北米|ほくべい}. The full form {北|きた}アメリカ is more common in everyday speech and writing, while {北米|ほくべい} is a Sino-Japanese abbreviation used in news, formal writing, and compound terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {北|きた}アメリカ{大陸|たいりく}: the North American continent
- {北|きた}アメリカ{諸国|しょこく}: North American countries
- {北|きた}アメリカ{原産|げんさん}: native to North America

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {北米|ほくべい}: North America — Sino-Japanese abbreviation; more formal and compact
- {南|みなみ}アメリカ: South America — the southern counterpart
- {中|ちゅう}アメリカ: Central America — the region between North and South America
